question: 步行路网上地铁中山湖站与海乐城之间最短距离几米？
answer: 沿步行路网约 2,390 米。

steps.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'metro_stations' AS layer, t.name, "station_type"::text AS category, (SELECT d.name FROM districts d WHERE ST_Within(t.geom, d.geom) LIMIT 1) AS district, 'name' AS matched_by, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.name) AS same_name_count FROM "metro_stations" t WHERE t.name LIKE '%中山湖%') u ORDER BY length(name), name LIMIT 25

WITH a_p AS (SELECT t.geom AS pt FROM "metro_stations" t WHERE t.name = '中山湖' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), a AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid, ST_Distance(p.pt::geography, v.geom::geography) AS snap_m FROM a_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, geom FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v), b_p AS (SELECT t.geom AS pt FROM "pois" t WHERE t.name = '海乐城' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), b AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid, ST_Distance(p.pt::geography, v.geom::geography) AS snap_m FROM b_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, geom FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v), r AS (SELECT * FROM pgr_dijkstra('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', (SELECT vid FROM a), (SELECT vid FROM b), false)) SELECT (SELECT coalesce(max(agg_cost), 0) FROM r) AS walk_m, (SELECT coalesce(max(agg_cost), 0) FROM r) / 80.0 AS walk_min, ST_Distance(a.pt::geography, b.pt::geography) AS straight_m, a.snap_m AS snap_a_m, b.snap_m AS snap_b_m, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_LineMerge((SELECT ST_Collect(e.geom ORDER BY r.seq) FROM r JOIN walk_edges e ON e.id = r.edge)), 6) AS geojson FROM a, b
